summary: Backend-only regression for the new MFA authentication flow. Full PHPUnit suite green: 159 passed / 498 assertions / 4.33s — matches the spec's target exactly (previous baseline 148 tests + 11 new MfaFlowTest cases = 159). All 11 tests/Feature/Auth/MfaFlowTest.php cases pass (56 assertions), covering: ambassador login without MFA, activation does not force MFA enrolment, enable MFA via Livewire AmbassadorSecurity (start/confirmEnrolment w/ wrong+correct TOTP), MFA challenge flow (redirect to /login/2fa, wrong code rejection, correct TOTP auth), one-shot recovery code consumption, regenerate recovery codes (no overlap), disable MFA (wrong+correct password), User::requiresPanelMfa() semantics for super_admin (always true) / admin (follows flag) / ambassador (always false / no panel access). AdminPanelProvider::panel() confirmed at line 42-44: `->multiFactorAuthentication(..., isRequired: fn (?\App\Models\User $user): bool => $user?->requiresPanelMfa() ?? false)` — closure, not boolean true, per spec.

specific_cases_verified: ambassador can log in without mfa
ambassador activation does not require mfa enrolment
ambassador can enable mfa from the security page
mfa enrolment rejects a wrong code
ambassador with mfa enabled must pass the challenge to log in
recovery code can be used once to log in
ambassador can disable mfa with correct password
super admin always requires panel mfa
admin requires panel mfa by default
ambassador does not require panel mfa at all

filament_closure_verification.conclusion: isRequired is a Closure that consults User::requiresPanelMfa(), NOT a bare boolean — matches spec.

critical_code_review_comments: MFA enrolment is now opt-in for ambassadors and configurable-with-default-on for admin/support, while super_admin is always forced via User::requiresPanelMfa() — matches product spec.
TwoFactorChallengeController rate-limits 10/min per user+ip, uses Google2FA window=2, and falls back to recovery-code consumption — recovery codes correctly one-shot removed from the array on use.

AmbassadorSecurity Livewire component uses #[SensitiveParameter] on the disable password and audits all state transitions (mfa_enabled, mfa_disabled, mfa_recovery_regenerated, challenge passed/failed) via AuditLogger.
AdminPanelProvider uses a Closure (not boolean) for isRequired — ensures Super Admin still forced through Filament panel MFA while allowing admins to have it toggled off by a Super Admin.
test_credentials: Verified via /app/memory/test_credentials.md — preview-admin@example.com / AdminPass1234! (super admin, panel MFA forced) and preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234 (ambassador w/o MFA). Not exercised over HTTP in this iteration — MfaFlowTest.php covers every branch in-process against SQLite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline is now 159 tests / 498 assertions (was 148/442; +11 tests / +56 assertions from MfaFlowTest). Route inventory added: GET /login/2fa (login.challenge), POST /login/2fa (login.challenge.submit), GET /ambassador/security (ambassador.security). Livewire component App\Livewire\AmbassadorSecurity backs /ambassador/security. If future slices modify LoginController branching, preserve the invariant: user with mfa_enabled && mfaConfigured() && no-panel-role → stash mfa.pending_user_id + redirect to login.challenge; otherwise Auth::login + role-based redirect. requiresPanelMfa() must remain: super_admin ⇒ true, others ⇒ mfa_enabled flag, ambassador-only users don't hit the panel (canAccessPanel returns false).
